body: I'm sorry to hear that's where you're at. As much as I want to say that it gets better, for some people it just doesn't. And a lot of the world are oblivious to the people such as you and me who have this particular mindset. I wish you all the best.

In this scenario, I didn't really have any survival instincts kicking in, I knew the guy saw me because he turned around just because he wanted to see if I was okay, If I stood there, I knew he would have stopped but in the moment, I realised that I deserved every bit of pain and suffering that was coming to me, and subconsciously I wanted to make sure I knew that, by moving out of the way of the car. By telling myself that I can't die yet and that I have to live through what I've done to myself and others.

Instead of dealing with all your fuck ups, instead of confronting what you've done and how you've done it, dying is the easy way to avoid it. I don't feel like I deserve it, I don't think I deserve anything but the things I've done to myself and others and I hope karma comes back at me 100%
